items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: George, with George a couple of years ago I might have managed [emigration criteria]. But now, you know we’re even older and he’s had problems and we all have problems.

ctx.x: And he also studied with Milt Hinton and, you know, these guys. And they give so much to the students. As long as the students are really interested. But yeah, I don’t know, I guess I know I’m lucky. And that’s one nice thing about that Kenji lives in Sweden and they really support the arts there and they really support the artists there. And I think he’s going to be teaching but he’s going to be teaching because he wants to. And he plays whenever he wants and he has healthcare, and they give a stipend to…
